# Code

> A live, read-only view of every repository on Joel's machine: which of
> its trees are being written, which of its changes wait and on what, the
> cells at work in each, and what's worth a look.

- [The page](index.html): the grove, the repositories as a list walked by
  keyboard or pointer, and the one the cursor is on beside them.
- [The page as text](index.md): how to read it, the keys, and what the
  data holds.
- The data: the repos daemon's records, which the page watches live over
  the sites' server at /feed/repos. An agent on the machine runs
  `repos --json` itself, or loads the repos skill.
- [All his sites](../llms.txt): the home this page sits in.
